title: lippia gratissima var. schulziae
intro: Lippia gratissima var. schulziae, commonly known as the "Wild Marjoram" or "Sweet Marjoram", is a plant species belonging to the family Verbenaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include relief from fever, headache, and respiratory issues, as well as its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lippia gratissima var. schulziae include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and carminative effects, which help to soothe digestive issues and relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
